execution.reason: Policy-contract proposal and synthetic checks only. No 2026 or <=2025 data loading, fitting, inference, OPE or scoring is authorized by this file.

proposal_convention: status=proposal fields are scientific proposals, not measured facts or registered choices. null means not selected, not built or not verified. No hash is invented.

governing_rules.intended_target_vs_realized_delivery: realized plate location is post-action delivery, never intended target

ARM_A.support_rule: observer supported_actions: every-count kernel ESS>=20 and mass>=.01 (existing, observational smoothing)

candidate_formula.value: pi_A(g,z|H) proportional to pi_ref_A(g,z|H)*exp(Q_A(H,(g,z))/tau_A) on support

ARM_A.existing_observer_baseline: observer-repertoire-kernel-v1 (realized-delivery kernel; not TRAIN categorical BC, not intent)

ARM_B.action_vocabulary: sorted unique pitch-type codes of frozen TRAIN BC

reference.formula: SupportedBC.probabilities: CategoricalBC(prior_strength=20, minimum_action_count=1) restricted/renormalised on frozen support once, before freezing

candidate.formula: kl_policy(Q_ref(H,.), pi_ref_B(.|H), M(H), tau): pi proportional to pi_ref*exp(Q_ref/tau) on M (existing P3)
candidate.q_source: frozen simulator MC of pi_ref (SupportedBC) continuation, recomputed at every decision
candidate.tau_existing_reference: EXP-P8-001 tau=.003 selected in June 2025 blend, G2 control world (D65); not transferable if the predictor changes

rationale.value: finite nonzero ratios on M; argmax variants have rho=0 off the chosen action. Not a guarantee of higher ESS; ESS to be measured in V2

primary.value: frozen TRAIN CategoricalBC.probabilities over the full registered TRAIN vocabulary, NOT restricted to M; distinct identity from pi_ref

sensitivity.value: TRAIN pitcher-frequency law over the same full vocabulary

logging_nuisance_pi_b_hat.equality_condition: pi_b_hat(M(H)|H) = 1 for every registered H; only then pi_ref == pi_b_hat and rho_ref == 1; to be checked on TRAIN tables, not assumed
logging_nuisance_pi_b_hat.derivation: IS identity requires the actual logging law; renormalising onto M inflates in-M ratios by pi_b(M|H) and makes out-of-M logged actions undefined (dropping = post-treatment selection; counting as 0 = pi_b(M|H) scaling). Synthetic: conditional -0.00286, as-zero -0.21449.

policy_mask.value: M(H) = positive TRAIN BC support AND TRAIN token vocabulary AND action-specific TRAIN delivery pool for all 12 counts (matrix_policy.PolicyInputs.support); restricts intervention actions only, never the logging law

candidate.value: Q_cand MC if budget allows, else declared control variate Q_ref

q_hat.note: With Q_ref as candidate control variate, the candidate outcome-model route is closed; candidate unbiasedness rests on pi_b_hat alone.

all_required: consistency: logged label equals registered intervention action
at least one of: pi_b_hat equals the true 2026 logging law (cross-year transport) OR q_hat^pi equals the policy-specific true Q under 2026 dynamics
value defined relative to frozen WE continuation (model value, not observed wins)

common.decision_history: pre-pitch game state + strictly previous same-PA pitches (type, physics, outcome, pre-pitch count) + frozen profiles; no current/future pitch fields

profile_as_of.value: frozen pre-2026 snapshot; no 2026 rolling profile/repertoire update

common.evaluation_start: first pitch 0-0 of each PA, weight 1 (D87 proposal)
common.horizon: PA end, then frozen WE continuation
common.initial_defender: Top->home, Bot->away; fixed through half-inning change
common.effect: delta = V(cand) - V(ref); delta_pp = 100*delta; positive favours initial defender; offense view = -delta
common.cap_tail: frozen WE at initial state plus worst-case [0,1] bounds (P8 convention)
common.tie_rule: deterministic argmax ties -> first index in sorted vocabulary
legitimate_refusals: estimated logging probability exactly 0 at logged action (LOGGING_POSITIVITY)

estimator.formula: V_T=0; V_t = v(H_t) + rho_t*(r_t + V_{t+1} - q(H_t,a_t)); rho_t = pi(a_t|H_t)/pi_b_hat(a_t|H_t); reward only at PA end; paired per PA

legacy_reuse.src/pitcheezy/ope/dr.py::traj_dr_terms_r: numerically equal on valid inputs (synthetic); no input validation
legacy_reuse.src/pitcheezy/ope/ips.py::pitch_ratios: do_not_reuse: NaN pi_b -> rho=1, pi_b=0 floored to 1e-12
legacy_reuse.src/pitcheezy/ope/ips.py::restrict_suppo: do_not_reuse at evaluation, and never on the logging law: silent renormalisation
